newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Caterpillar to expand in Sweden - agency.
newsitem.headline: Caterpillar to expand in Sweden - agency.

text.p: U.S. heavy machinery company Caterpillar Inc is investing in a new type of forestry machine for the world market that is to be developed in Sweden, Swedish national news agency TT reported on Tuesday.
Caterpillar has bought Swedish forestry machinery maker Skogsjan in the start of a Nordic expansion.
"In Sweden the company will manufacture a series of equipment which will fell, chop and sort timber in a forest," TT said.
Reports say the deal could mean 150 new jobs in the area of Soderhamn on central Sweden's coast, TT said. It gave no financial details of the deal.
